text.text_excerpt: Let's start with the fact Ms Beasley is the most humble and sweetest lady I've come across in a while. She's so sincere about honestly just wanting everyone to eat better and be as healthy as possible. You can taste the love in her meals. Now to the meat of the review. Or should I say the lack there of. She doesn't serve any meat. That alone had me almost running to her truck for seconds. (Yes, I literally went back and ordered another meal after I finished my first to save for dinner that evening.) I stood there in shock when viewed the menu for the first time. I texted my partner in excitement that I found another food truck I could obsess over. I finally decided on the veggie burger pl...

So glad to finally see a vegetarian food truck! This place is new and has posted up by the Tulane medical center at lunch time. When I went to grab a late lunch at 2pm, they were the only truck still serving, and I'm so glad I walked over to investigate. I'll have to go back and snap a photo of the truck and the menu, but there were a lot of delicious-sounding veggie options, mostly bean-based (no fake meat, which makes me happy). I had the red beans with quinoa, which were very flavorful and filling without being super heavy. The lady working the truck, who I'm pretty sure was the owner and chef, was very, very sweet and friendly. I've often wondered at the lack of healthy options outsid...

Calling all Vegans and Vegetarians finally a food truck for us! Well I'm a pescatarian but we all fam. Ms. Beasley will even turn some of you meat eaters into believers. Do not pass this truck up. Even if you don't get food grab a smoothie they're amazing. Today I had a black bean burger so good that when I offered my partner a second bite I almost lost my thumb. Her food is so well seasoned. Which lets just be honest can be confused with salty a lot in New Orleans. However that's not the chase with her. She going for getting the good stuff in you. One thing I loved in addition to the actual burger is the garden fresh sides. Literally garden fresh from her garden!
